summary: First-finish smoke test of Sutan Khulifah POS. Backend: admin+kasir login, /me sanitization, invalid-token 401, business setup (retail+fnb), category/product create, duplicate SKU 400, sale checkout, insufficient stock 400, insufficient cash 400, customer loyalty increment, inventory adjust +/- with movements, movements sorted desc, role protection (kasir 403 on product, 200 on customer), dashboard payload — ALL PASS. Frontend: login flow, dashboard renders with metrics/chart, POS page renders products and cart panel.
passed: POST /api/business (retail and fnb) → 200 with correct fields (FIX VERIFIED)
POST /api/sales returns invoice_no, subtotal, total, change; deducts stock; logs movement
POST /api/sales insufficient stock → 400 'Insufficient stock for Prod1'
Customer loyalty_points, total_spent, visit_count incremented after sale
POST /api/inventory/adjust +5 and -3 update product.stock and log movement
GET /api/reports/dashboard returns revenue_today/total, transactions, top_products, daily_revenue, low_stock_items
Role protection: kasir → 403 on product create, 200 on customer create
Frontend login → /dashboard, sidebar renders, KPI cards populated
POS page loads product tiles and cart with pos-total testid
